prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. GAME SPRITE ANIMATION SHEET, exactly 6 columns and 3 rows, 18 distinct complete poses. Reference images 1-3 define strict Rift Hunters art direction: angular dark fantasy monsters, crisp fine pixel clusters, jagged faceted shading, selective dark outline. Charcoal, ash-grey and burnt ochre palette with very sparse dark-red embers; corruption is spectral grey-white pale eyes and fine cold fissures, absolutely no primary magenta. Upper-left light. All poses same character, face RIGHT with slight overhead three-quarter view. Equal square cells, landscape 2:1 sheet, each figure fits entirely within its cell with generous empty gutters, consistent scale and ground baseline. Every frame is a visibly different meaningful animation pose, never duplicate standing sprites. No background glow, no ground shadow, no backdrop or panels, absolutely no words, no labels, no grid lines. Output truly transparent RGBA, zero-alpha outside sprite; crisp clean cutout with no atmospheric halo. Effects only attached to or emitted directly from body, never danger circles or detached floor zones. Create original Cinder Knight: burnt armored humanoid knight physically fused with charred timber, a narrow leaning body with tall splintered wooden growths replacing one shoulder, boxy soot-black iron helmet with a thin smoldering dark-red visor and two tiny pale ghostly eyes, heavy single-edged butcher cleaver blade carried low in one hand, ragged burnt cape in three long strips. Burnt ochre bark integrated into greaves and riblike breastplate. Menacing executioner silhouette, extremely asymmetric wooden shoulder versus low wide cleaver, no polearm, no silver armor, no horns, no resemblance to beetle or dragon references. ROW1 six successive heavy walking gait poses: distinct alternating greaves step, cape strips swing, low cleaver sways, shoulder tilts. ROW2 six successive basic cleaver attack poses: 1 ready, 2 draws blade back, 3 raises cleaver by twisting torso, 4 powerful diagonal chop to RIGHT, 5 low follow-through, 6 returns to ready. ROW3 six death sequence poses: staggers, one knee buckles, falls to knees dropping cleaver, topples sideways, burnt timber and armor disintegrate, small collapsed ash and armor remnants. Clear temporal movement and consistent individual character.
